title: Pyramidal Columns Acting as Attention Heads
abstract: arXiv:2611.16057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can the functional architecture of a Transformer attention head be given a biological construction? More specifically, could a suitable group of pyramidal columns in posterior temporal language regions (PTLRs) constitute the biological construction of a neuromorphic mechanical realization of an attention head, under a mathematical instantiation that need not coincide with its standard Transformer instantiation? This paper investigates this hypothesis by examining possible correspondences between the functional organization of attention heads and neurophysiological mechanisms operating within and across pyramidal columns involved in human language processing. Our analysis builds on a mechanical-structural description of Transformer attention heads as systems of simple neural networks linked through output-input and output-weight interconnections. translated_title: 充当注意力头的锥体神经元柱
translated_abstract: Transformer注意力头的功能架构能否被赋予一种生物学构造？更具体地说，在后颞叶语言区（PTLRs）中，一组合适的锥体神经元柱能否在一种不必与其标准Transformer实例化相一致的数学实例化下，构成注意力头的神经形态机械实现的生物学构造？本文通过考察注意力头的功能组织与参与人类语言处理的锥体神经元柱内部及之间运作的神经生理机制之间可能存在的对应关系，来检验这一假设。我们的分析建立在将Transformer注意力头机械-结构性地描述为通过输出-输入与输出-权重互连相链接的简单神经网络系统之上。我们考察了注意力头的功能组织以及依赖输入的变换……
tldr: 该论文提出后颞叶语言区中的锥体神经元柱群可能在生物学上实现Transformer注意力头的功能，并系统考察了注意力头的功能组织与人类语言处理中神经生理机制之间的对应关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that a suitable group of pyramidal columns in posterior temporal language regions could constitute the biological realization of a Transformer attention head, by examining correspondences between the functional organization of attention heads and neurophysiological mechanisms in human language processing.
